gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma or gliosarcoma as confirmed by local histopathology

candidate_evidence.quote: The study explores the addition of pembrolizumab to temozolomide-based radiotherapy in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Expression levels of PD-L1 will be determined in the tumor tissue and correlated with response as determined by MRI and progression-free as well as overall survival

role_evidence.quote: Pembrolizumab will be added to standard of care
In this study, pembrolizumab will be administered (200 mg every 3 weeks) in addition to TMZ/RT=\>TMZ.
Temozolomide-based radiochemotherapy (TMZ/RT=\>TMZ) represents the standard of care for patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

source_quote.quote: Absence of isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH)1 R132H mutation by immunohistochemistry
Expression levels of PD-L1 will be determined in the tumor tissue and correlated with response as determined by MRI and progression-free as well as overall survival

coder_notes: Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but every patient receives TMZ/RT=>TMZ as standard of care, so listed as soc_backbone. IDH-wildtype requirement defines GBM (never candidate-matched). PD-L1 tissue expression is a correlative endpoint only, mechanistically linked to pembrolizumab; not an entry requirement. Quotes containing 'RT=\>TMZ' reproduce the record's escaped characters.
